digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler tickets-store and bridge-state cache
propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% being reconciler .bridge_state cache; ~1 GiB can be reclaimed by optimizing committed cache content and deleting unnecessary historical bookkeeping fields.

The baseline_advanced_at timestamp field changes 1144 times per reconciler pass but is never read in src/, defeating git delta compression; deleting it reduces marginal packed cost per version from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB.
The last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping field changes 20 times per pass and should be relocated to get_rotation.json as a sidecar to further halve storage growth during the transition period.

A filtered git history rewrite using git fast-export/filter-import reduces the real branch from 1.17 GB to 99 MB (8.4% final size) while preserving all commits and merges and maintaining byte-identical HEAD tree after dynamic re-add.

The rollout requires staged gate closures: A2-1 (move rotation field) gated by descendant workflow execution and host refresh; A6-1 (history rewrite) gated by epoch mismatch refusal in both reconciler and review-bot, deployment receipts, quiescence confirmation, and off-repo backup verification.

Post-publish rollback requires explicit re-quiescence, bundle verification, ref force-with-lease restoration, writer re-cloning around epoch mismatch, and tree/count/identity checks before re-enabling writes.
